meta.siteDescription: Upload a photo to identify a snake and understand its potential venom risk. AI-assisted, safety first, honest about uncertainty.

common.notYetTranslatedNote: Not yet translated. Shown in English.

footer.disclaimer: Serpent gives AI-assisted estimates from photographs. It can be wrong. It is not a substitute for a qualified wildlife professional or medical care. If someone has been bitten, call your local emergency number now.

landing.lead: One photo. Serpent compares it against {count} species and tells you plainly how dangerous it may be — or says {unknown} when it can't be sure.

home.title: Identify a snake
home.lead: Upload a photo to identify the snake and understand its potential venom risk.
home.neverApproach: Never approach or handle a snake to get a better photograph.
home.exampleLookAlikeNote: A photo can't tell them apart reliably.

photograph.title: Photograph from where you stand
photograph.body: Take or upload one photo. Don't move closer; zoom is fine.

check.title: Check the photo
check.body: Blurry, dark or partial photos get “can’t identify reliably”, not a guess.

match.title: Match against verified records
match.body: The AI ranks species from a curated database. It can't invent new ones.

safety.title: Safety first, then details
safety.body: You see what to do before you see the species, venom and risk.

home.promisesTitle: Built to be honest about what a photo can and can’t tell you

harmless.title: It won’t call a snake harmless
harmless.body: Even a confident non-venomous match comes with a reminder that photos mislead, and a warning when dangerous look-alikes exist.

score.title: It won’t invent a venom score
score.body: Potency and medical risk are shown separately. If there’s no citable laboratory value, you see that, not a number.

unknown.title: “Unknown” is a real answer
unknown.body: When the evidence is weak or conflicting, the result says so and tells you to treat the snake as dangerous.

identify.title: Identify a snake
identify.lead: One snake per photo. Show as much of the body and head as you can see from a safe distance.
identify.warning: Never move closer to a snake for a better photo.
identify.maxPhotos: You can add up to {max} photos of the same snake, for example the head and the body pattern.
identify.countryHint: Optional. Helps rank species found in your area and choose the site language. Saved on this device.
identify.lowResOne: This photo is quite small. Results may be unreliable.
identify.lowResMany: One of these photos is quite small. Results may be unreliable.
identify.roomOne: Add up to 1 more photo of the same snake if you have one. Only photograph from where you are.
identify.roomMany: Add up to {n} more photos of the same snake if you have them. Only photograph from where you are.

notice.uploadKnown: Your photo is resized and stripped of location data on this device, then sent to {product}, an AI model by {company}, for analysis. Serpent does not store it.
notice.uploadUnknown: Your photo is resized and stripped of location data on this device, then sent to an external AI model for analysis. Serpent does not store it.
notice.privacyKnown: Resized and stripped of metadata (including GPS location) on your device, then sent to our server and on to {company}'s {product} API for analysis. Serpent does not save it. It is processed by {company} under its API terms.
notice.privacyUnknown: Resized and stripped of metadata (including GPS location) on your device, then sent to our server and on to an external AI provider for analysis. Serpent does not save it.

progress.analyzing: AI is examining the photo and matching it against our species database

errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

photo.not_a_photo: That file isn't a photo. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
photo.too_large_to_open: That photo is too large to open.
photo.format_unsupported: This browser can't open that photo format. Try a JPEG or PNG, or take the photo in the app.

api.rate_limited: Too many photos in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
api.upload_too_large: These photos are too large. Try smaller images.
api.upload_unreadable: The upload could not be read. Try again.
api.too_many_photos: Send at most {max} photos of the same snake.
api.photo_too_large: This photo is too large. Try a smaller image.
api.photo_too_small: This file is too small to be a usable photo.
api.photo_bad_type: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.

result.noResultBody: The latest result stays in this browser tab only and is cleared when it closes. Past results saved on this device are in History. Analyze a photo to see one here.
result.listedAs: The closest match is listed as {status}, but a venomous species can't be ruled out from this photo.
result.geoNone: Location not provided, so geography wasn't used.
result.geoOutside: Not recorded in {country}; this lowered the ranking.
result.variationNote: Colour, head shape and pattern vary between individuals and can mislead even experts.
result.estimatesNote: These are the AI's relative estimates after geographic adjustment, not measured probabilities.
result.basisNotAssessed: Venom not assessed for this species or its genus
result.treatDangerous: Treat this snake as potentially dangerous. If it is in or near a home, contact local wildlife rescue.
result.serviceUnavailableNote: No result was produced, so none is shown. Try again in a moment. Until then, treat the snake as potentially dangerous.
result.engineFooter: AI estimate from {product} ({model}), {date}. Visual identification can be wrong.

candidate.notInDatabase: A species not in our database

status.likely_identified: Most likely identification shown below. Visual identification can be wrong.
status.conflicting_evidence: Several species with different venom profiles match this photo. Do not rely on this result to decide whether the snake is safe.
status.unknown_species: We couldn't identify this snake reliably.
status.insufficient_image: The image is not clear enough for reliable identification.
status.no_snake: We couldn't detect a snake in this image.
status.multiple_snakes: Multiple snakes detected. Please analyze one snake at a time.

issues.partially_hidden: Part of the snake is hidden.
issues.too_small: The snake is too small in the frame.
issues.obstructed: Something is blocking the view of the snake.
issues.low_resolution: The photo resolution is too low.
issues.multiple_snakes: More than one snake is visible.
issues.no_snake: No snake was found in the photo.
issues.not_a_live_snake_photo: This doesn't look like a photo of a real snake.

potentially_venomous.label: Potentially venomous
potentially_venomous.short: Cannot be ruled out from this photo

mildly_venomous.label: Mildly venomous
mildly_venomous.short: Venom usually causes only local symptoms

neurotoxic.label: Neurotoxic
neurotoxic.description: Affects the nervous system. Can interfere with muscle control and breathing.

hemotoxic.label: Hemotoxic
hemotoxic.description: Affects blood clotting and can cause bleeding or damage to blood vessels.

cytotoxic.label: Cytotoxic
cytotoxic.description: Damages tissue around the bite, causing swelling and blistering.

cardiotoxic.label: Cardiotoxic
cardiotoxic.description: Can affect how the heart works.

actions.stayBack: Stay well back and give the snake a clear path to leave.
actions.noTouch: Do not touch, catch, corner or try to kill the snake.
actions.children: Keep children and pets away from the area.
actions.rescue: If the snake is inside a home or busy area, contact local wildlife rescue or emergency services.
actions.retake: If you try again, photograph from where you are. Do not move closer for a better shot.
actions.spitting: This species can spray venom toward the eyes. Keep well back and protect your face.

safety.lookAlike: This snake may resemble species with different venom profiles. Identification from a photograph is not reliable enough to rule out a dangerous species. Do not approach it.

notes.typo: The AI wrote "{namedAs}"; the closest recognised name is {resolved}.
notes.unreviewedInGroup: {name} is a recognised species that Serpent hasn't reviewed yet. It belongs to {common} ({group}), which we treat as venomous.
notes.unreviewedNotAssessed: {name} is a recognised species that Serpent hasn't reviewed yet, and its venom hasn't been assessed. Treat it as potentially venomous.
notes.groupPoints: It points to {common} ({group}), which we treat as venomous.
notes.groupSuggested: The AI suggested "{namedAs}", which isn't a recognised species name. It points to {common} ({group}), which we treat as venomous.
notes.unrecognised: The AI suggested "{namedAs}", which isn't a recognised snake name, so its venom status could not be checked.
notes.notInDatabase: The photo may show a species that is not in our database.
notes.partialOnly: Only part of the snake could be assessed, so these are low-confidence possibilities, not an identification.
notes.outsideCountry: This species is not recorded in {country}. The result was down-weighted but not excluded.
notes.secondOpinionAgreed: Two independent analyses agreed on the closest match.
notes.secondOpinionDisagreed: Two independent analyses disagreed on the closest match, so confidence stays limited.
notes.legacyResult: This result was saved before translations were available, so its safety text is shown in English.

report.sent: Thank you. Your report was sent anonymously and will be reviewed to improve identifications.
report.title: Report a wrong identification
report.lead: Sent anonymously with this result's ID. Your photo is not sent. Please don't include personal details.
report.speciesLabel: What species do you think it is?
report.failed: The report could not be sent. Try again later.
report.failedNetwork: The report could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
report.rateLimited: Too many reports in a short time. Try again later.
report.unreadable: The report could not be read.

emergency.treatEvery: Treat every snakebite as an emergency, even if there is little pain or the snake looked small. Some venoms cause no early symptoms.
emergency.noVerifiedNumber: Call your local emergency number. We don't have a verified number for {country} yet.
emergency.chooseCountry: Call your local emergency number. Choose your country below to see it here.
emergency.numbersDisclaimer: Numbers are listed for convenience and may change. If a number does not connect, use any local emergency number you know.
emergency.firstAidLead: First aid buys time; it does not treat the bite. Antivenom and hospital monitoring do. If the emergency operator gives different instructions, follow the operator.

do.moveAway: Move away from the snake to a safe place.
do.call: Call your local emergency number or get to a hospital now, even if you feel fine. Some venoms cause few early symptoms.
do.calm: Keep the person calm and as still as possible. Movement can speed the spread of venom.
do.limb: Keep the bitten limb still, for example with a splint or sling.
do.rings: Remove rings, watches, bracelets and tight clothing near the bite before swelling starts.
do.time: Note the time of the bite and any symptoms as they appear.
do.eyes: If venom was sprayed into the eyes, rinse them with plenty of clean water.

dont.suck: Do not try to suck out the venom.
dont.tourniquet: Do not apply a tight tourniquet.
dont.ice: Do not put ice on the bite.
dont.remedies: Do not drink alcohol or take herbal or traditional remedies.
dont.catch: Do not try to catch or kill the snake. A photo from a safe distance is enough.
dont.wait: Do not wait to see if symptoms develop.

regional.auPressure: In Australia, a pressure immobilisation bandage is standard first aid for snakebite. The emergency operator can talk you through applying it.
regional.auNoWash: In Australia, do not wash the bite site. Hospitals may test it to identify the venom.

contacts.nhs111Note: For urgent medical advice; call 999 for a snakebite emergency

speciesList.title: Species reference
speciesList.lead: Reviewed species are listed first. Search also covers every other recognised snake species; those pages show names and distribution from The Reptile Database, with venom data from genus level or not yet assessed. Reviewed records are drafts awaiting expert review; each page says what has and hasn't been verified.
speciesList.searchLabel: Search by name, family or country
speciesList.otherLead: Names from The Reptile Database. Venom data for these comes from genus or family level, or is not assessed.

species.draftNote: Draft record. This information has not yet been checked by a qualified reviewer against its sources.
species.featuresNote: No single feature is reliable on its own. Individuals vary.
species.notReviewedGroupStrong: Not yet reviewed: venom data from {level} level.
species.notReviewedGroupBody: This species belongs to {common} ({name}), which Serpent treats as dangerously venomous. Its own venom and medical risk have not been reviewed.
species.notReviewedNoneStrong: Not yet reviewed: venom not assessed.
species.notReviewedNoneBody: Serpent has no venom data for this species or its genus, so identifications show it as potentially venomous. Do not assume it is harmless.
species.distributionNote: As recorded in the source. This release can omit part of a species' range, so absence from this list does not mean the species is absent from an area.
species.noDistribution: The source has no distribution for this species.
species.adapted: Adapted for Serpent: filtered to snakes and reformatted.
species.venomRuleGroup: Venom status is Serpent's own {level}-level rule, not part of the source.
species.venomRuleDefault: Venom status is Serpent's own fail-safe default, not part of the source.

venomPanel.riskExplainer: Medical risk is how dangerous a real bite can be to a person: it weighs venom, typical amount delivered, how often bites happen and how they are treated. {risk} indicates potential severity, not a guaranteed outcome.
venomPanel.potencyDesc: How toxic the venom is under standardized laboratory tests.
venomPanel.noPotency: No sourced laboratory value yet. We don't show a number we can't cite.
venomPanel.noAntivenom: Availability not yet sourced. Hospitals and poison centres know which antivenom is used locally.
venomPanel.mildProfile: Mild venom; no medically significant toxin activity is recorded for this species.

sources.none: No sources linked yet. This record needs sourcing before launch.
sources.notVerified: Not yet verified by a reviewer

history.title: History
history.lead: Your past identifications, saved only in this browser on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
history.clearConfirm: Delete every saved result from this device? This can't be undone.
history.actionFailed: Couldn't change History in this browser. Try again.
history.emptyBody: Results you get on this device will appear here.
history.unavailableTitle: History isn't available in this browser.
history.unavailableBody: This can happen in private browsing or when site data is blocked. Identifying a snake still works as usual.
history.saveSetting: Save my results on this device
history.saveSettingHint: When this is off, new results aren't saved. Results already saved stay until you delete them.
history.privacyNote: History never leaves this browser. It's erased when you clear it here or clear your browser data.
history.savedFrom: Saved result from {date}. Species information may have been updated since.
history.notFoundTitle: This saved result is no longer on this device
history.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or History was cleared.
history.savedHere: Saved to History on this device only.

nearMe.title: Snakes near me
nearMe.lead: Choose a city to see which snakes have been recorded around it, dangerous ones first.
nearMe.heading: Snakes recorded near {city}
nearMe.basis: Based on public sighting records within 50 km. Shows where snakes have been reported, not exactly how common they are.
nearMe.placesUnavailable: Place search isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.
nearMe.locationDenied: Location permission wasn't given. Search for your city instead.
nearMe.locationUnavailable: Your location couldn't be found. Search for your city instead.
nearMe.locationNoPlace: No town found near your location. Search for your city instead.
nearMe.locationNote: Your position is rounded to about 10 km before it leaves your device, and it is never stored.
nearMe.loadingSlow: Looking up a new area can take up to a minute.
nearMe.unavailable: We couldn't load sightings for this area right now.
nearMe.rateLimited: Too many searches in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
nearMe.noRecords: No snake records found within 50 km. That doesn't mean there are no snakes here.
nearMe.dangerousLead: Snakes with medically significant venom, highest medical risk first.
nearMe.otherLead: Most likely non-venomous, or not assessed. Keep your distance from every snake: telling species apart from a distance is unreliable.
nearMe.noneDangerous: No venomous snakes are in these records. Records are incomplete, so treat any snake you can't identify as potentially venomous.
nearMe.notAssessed: Not assessed — treat as potentially venomous
nearMe.callLocal: Call your local emergency number now.
nearMe.ncExcluded: Records licensed for non-commercial use only (CC BY-NC) are not included.
nearMe.placesCredit: Place search by Photon, place data {osm}.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What happens to your photo and data.
privacy.resultBody: Your latest result is kept in this browser tab, together with a small thumbnail, and cleared when you close the tab. A copy is also saved to History on this device unless you turn that off.
privacy.historyBody: Past results and their small thumbnails are saved in this browser on this device only, so you can look at them again. History is never uploaded or sent to us. On the History page you can turn saving off, delete single results or clear it all; clearing your browser data erases it too.
privacy.nearMeBody: To find records, the city you choose, or your location rounded to about 10 km, is sent to our server and from there to GBIF (sighting records) and Photon (place names). We keep only the rounded area, the place name and the records found, in a cache for up to 30 days, never who searched. Your last chosen city is remembered on this device only.
privacy.locationBody: Only the country you choose, if any. It's remembered on this device and in a cookie that lets the site pick your language on a first visit. We ask for your device's location only if you tap “Use my location” on Snakes near me, and it is rounded to about 10 km before it leaves your device.
privacy.languageBody: If you choose a language, it's saved in a cookie on this device so the site opens in that language next time.
privacy.reportsBody: If you report a wrong identification, we store the result ID, what was shown, and the species and note you typed. No image, IP address or account.
privacy.logsBody: An anonymous record of each analysis: the outcome, the top species and the confidence. No image, no IP address, no account.
privacy.rateLimitBody: Your network address is held briefly in memory to stop abuse, and is never written to storage.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: That page doesn't exist. If someone has been bitten, go straight to emergency guidance.
